## Rows

| dice | result | effect | severity | notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 11-13 | Wasted Time | Hours of careful work produce no usable progress. The materials remain, but the time is lost. | Low |  |
| 14-16 | Misfit Part | You shape or fit a piece incorrectly. The item cannot be finished until the part is redone. | Moderate |  |
| 21-23 | Split Material | Wood cracks, leather tears, or metal warps while you work it. Lose part of the raw materials. | Moderate |  |
| 24-26 | Dulled or Broken Tool | A key tool is damaged by the strain of the job. The work slows until you repair or replace it. | Moderate |  |
| 31-33 | Botched Repair | The repair seems sound at first, but the item's Gear Bonus drops one step instead of improving. | Moderate |  |
| 34-36 | Unsafe Build | The crafted item comes out flawed or unstable. It works briefly, then fails under real use. | High |  |
| 41-43 | Materials Spent | You ruin the batch, strip, or set of parts needed for the job. The raw materials are spent and must be replaced. | High |  |
| 44-46 | Exhausting Labor | The work takes more out of you than expected. Suffer 1 point of damage to Strength. | Moderate |  |
| 51-53 | Workshop Mishap | Sparks, blades, heat, or falling weight injure you during the work. Suffer an attack with three Base Dice. | High |  |
| 54-56 | Ruined Item | The item being repaired or crafted is rendered unusable. If it was already near failure, it is destroyed. | High |  |
| 61-63 | Costly Failure | You lose the item, the materials, and the time, and you cannot attempt the same project again until your approach changes. | Severe |  |
| 64-66 | Catastrophic Build | Your work causes a major break, dangerous failure, or destructive accident that affects more than just the item on the bench. | Catastrophic |  |
